time_scope_addendum.attachment_cache: c.attached was populated before integration from then-current eq_active. release_attachments may change eq_active after integration but leaves c.attached unchanged until the next control callback.

time_scope_addendum.guard_replay: Replay uses pre-integration distances, cached attached flags, phase, and step-end clock, matching the actual GPU audit. It does not use post-integration local centres to recompute penetration.
